reviewer: Independent delegated local source review; no hosted tools or mutation authority
scope: Pure B2 package/binder/CLI, fused proposal/manifest, static tests, disposable PostgreSQL setup and original source procedures, disabled existing v2 server contracts. No hosted execution or provider readiness is certified.
observations: Fused unbound template has no actual owner UUID and no execution hash; final B2 artifact requires genuine native Auth readback and separate exact approval.
Only two DML insert destinations: original busy_businesses and busy_business_memberships; original generated business UUID and actual native owner relationship.
No Auth creation, new onboarding RPC/table/store, ACL change, policy activation, provider credential or execution transport in package/CLI.
Known managed runner owns complete transaction and native history; no authored BEGIN/COMMIT. Locks/timeouts/current owner/empty state/history/RLS/ACL/policy checks preserved.
Native owner query selects only allowlisted non-secret columns; no password/token/payload or whole Auth-row read.
Exact byte reconstruction guards outer-fuse removal; changed SQL, UUID injections, wrong target/history and unbound documents fail closed.
Private packet output uses a new mode0700 directory and exclusive mode0600 fused files, never an execution derivative; overwrite is denied.
Disabled v2 entry returns503 before environment lookup and cannot populate source or activate providers. Genuine source runtime/authentication remains a separate readiness gate.
Fresh parser review confirms fixed parse/load error text and both entry-function/real-CLI malformed secret-like input omission assertions.
Original application runtime, provider implementation and approved foundation SQL remain unchanged in current local diff.

Both new PostgreSQL scripts gate on absolute Unix socket/data paths, PostgreSQL17, empty listen_addresses and exact local data_directory before DROP/CREATE of their respective hardcoded disposable database; no hosted URL is accepted.

B2 SQL rehearsal uses the exact original approved foundation in its own local DB, a minimal synthetic native Auth approximation and native-history shape. It tests rollback of late/history/deferred failures, concurrent duplication, effective ACL/column-DML/FORCE drift and retained owner state.

Source procedure uses the original connected session, profile CAS, privateWebsiteDraftAction, original commit/history/transition and actual original SQL functions in PostgreSQL mode. Mock auth.uid/request claims are explicit test-only mechanisms and are forbidden as hosted setup.

Full supplied story is retained in a protected original Studio text section while Home/Services/Contact remain image-free; unsupported initial profile fields are not inserted through an administrator shortcut.
Source tests preserve original unsupported whole-site profile-source-CAS denial, stale/foreign/revoked denial, lost acknowledgement non-replay and zero/disabled ledger state.

B3 hosted source population remains blocked on a genuine native owner session plus original trusted server/runtime; disabled v2 pilot cannot populate source, and no fake JWT/raw snapshot/service-key bypass is claimed.
